summary: Replace the technical JSON/XLSX dump with a fixed-English reviewer view and make English the only selectable application language. Material or equipment names, quantities, and units are separate, including English word, parenthesized, minimum, and single-item quantity prefixes; internal IDs, raw candidate JSON, hashes, field paths, standalone evidence tabs, and all PDF geometry audit output are removed. Evidence is displayed with each item, and conflict values, source locations, revision dates, and source text are shown side by side. Exact duplicate conflict statements are removed before comparison. Excel shows up to three concise numbered evidence excerpts per item while JSON retains all evidence. A final display sanitizer removes non-English punctuation shells, machine-style underscore names, raw null values, and unsupported PDF private-use font glyphs while preserving complete labels such as Sheet identifier and mapping verified engineering symbols to degree and micro. A local Qwen compatibility cache translates saved legacy business text with numeric-preservation, generic-disclaimer rejection, collision-rejection, and fail-closed missing-translation checks; future extraction and verification prompts request English reviewer text directly. The web default, credential page, launcher, dependency checks, public settings, and cost descriptions use English CIRP-owned text. Exporting continues to read saved data only and does not call a model.
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested English-only output labels, separate material or equipment name and quantity fields, removal of IDs and formatting noise, side-by-side conflict text and sources, evidence beside each item, removal of the PDF geometry audit tab, and the assumption that all users and developers use English.
known_limitations: Source-document quotations are not machine-translated; the fixed-English view suppresses isolated non-English OCR noise while preserving saved evidence.
A blank quantity means no usable saved quantity was stated or calculated and must not be interpreted as zero.
PDF paper-space geometry remains available in saved analysis support but is intentionally omitted from reviewer exports because it is not a material quantity.
Visual model observations remain labeled as model observations and require human review.
Excel shows up to three concise evidence excerpts per item; full evidence remains in the JSON export and application.
